name: tictac-arena
description: Real-time private-room multiplayer board games (MERN + Socket.IO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
